en: A black‑and‑white, likely early 20th‑century postcard-style photograph showing a large Gothic and Romanesque cathedral dominating a town square. The church has one massive Gothic tower at the west end, a long nave with flying buttresses and pointed windows, and a Romanesque‑looking east end with two large rose windows and round‑arched details. Smaller towers and surrounding multi‑story European townhouses frame the scene, with a tree‑lined open space in the foreground. No printed caption or handwriting is visible on the image.
